subject: Next steps: Eval triage and version pinning for HelioMetrics
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliometrics.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + immediate next steps from today’s discovery call

Hi Sarah / Mike —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Primary goal: improve candidate ranking quality in your customer support triage (short answers + rerank).
- Current stack: in-house finetune on Llama-2-13B and a lightweight reranker. Latency target: 200–400ms P95.
- Pain: recent model update coincided with a small but measurable drop in precision@10 on the weekly benchmark.

Our recommendations (quick):
1) Run the Redwood evaluation harness (we’ll share prompt sets) against two model candidates: rdx-13b-v1 (quantized) and rdx-13b-v1.1 (attention tweak).
2) Pin production to the last-known-good variant for the short term while we triage (we’ll supply exact model id + rollback steps).
3) Share your benchmark and a sample of failing prompts (we requested a 200-row prompt set during the call).

Action items / owners:
- Stephanie: Share prompt set template + eval harness links (attached).
- Rishi: Run quick diff between v1 and v1.1 and provide guidance on pin/rollback commands.
- Sarah / Mike: Send 200 sample prompts (anonymized).

I’ve attached the prompt_set template and a short how-to for running the Redwood eval. I’ll circle back once Rishi posts the diff.

Thanks again — looking forward to the samples.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliometrics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@heliometrics.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:12:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + immediate next steps from today’s discovery call

Thanks Stephanie — uploaded a 200-row sample to the shared Drive link you listed on the call (anonymized).

Quick update / concern: we just rolled rdx-13b-v1.1 into our staging yesterday and saw a drop in precision@10 from 0.71 -> 0.65 on the same evaluation harness you recommended. Latency looks stable. The regression is small but affects high-value flows so we’d like to pause any further autonomous rollouts.

Questions for the team:
- Can you confirm guidelines for pinning to a model id and for how long we should keep it pinned while triaging?
- Any immediate mitigations that aren’t full rollback (e.g., fallback routing to the previous variant for specific routes)?

Happy to hop on a quick triage call if that helps.

— Sarah
Head of ML Ops
HelioMetrics

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliometrics.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:08:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + immediate next steps from today’s discovery call

Hi Sarah — thanks for the sample and the heads up. I ran a targeted diff between rdx-13b-v1 (sha: a1b2c3) and rdx-13b-v1.1 (sha: d4e5f6) against your 200-row sample and the internal weekly benchmark. Key findings below.

Top-line: v1.1 introduced a modest precision drop driven by two template families (short prompt + numeric token parsing). Not a catastrophic change, but consistent.

Diff summary (high level):
- Regression bucket A: 28 prompts — responses truncated or overly generic (related to number/ID extraction).
- Regression bucket B: 14 prompts — reranker score shift (same candidates but ordering degraded).
- No latency regression.

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Pin production to rdx-13b-v1 (sha a1b2c3) immediately. Command (Console/API):
   - Console: Models > rdx-13b-v1 > Pin to route 'support-triage' (duration: indefinite)
   - API: POST /v1/routes/support-triage/pin {"model_id":"rdx-13b-v1","strategy":"pin"}
2) Route-by-path fallback: set per-route fallback to rdx-13b-v1 for requests matching /support/tickets/priority-high. This keeps v1.1 live for non-critical flows.
3) Hotfix prompt engineering: apply small prompt prefix that stabilizes numeric parsing for affected templates (I attached a suggested prefix and a diff report).

I attached eval_diff_report_20260304.html (static) with the per-prompt scoring diffs and the short prompt_prefix_patch.txt. Recommend pinning first while we validate the prompt patch on a canary.

Next steps I’ll take:
- If you approve, I’ll issue the pin for the route and spin up a canary with the prompt prefix for 2k requests.
- Run a 24-hour monitoring job to track precision@10 and P95 latency and report back.

Let me know your preference and I’ll act tonight (PDT).

— Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: eval_diff_report_20260304.html (text/html)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@heliometrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + immediate next steps from today’s discovery call

Sarah — thanks for raising this. Our recommendation is the conservative path: pin route 'support-triage' to rdx-13b-v1 (sha a1b2c3) now and run Rishi’s canary with the prompt prefix on a 2k-sample set.

I’ve scheduled the pin to go through if you confirm (we can do it within minutes and I’ll send the console change for audit). We’ll also open a short maintenance window for the canary test and provide a live dashboard link.

Proposed timeline (simple):
- Today, 09:00–09:30 PDT: pin model on route. (Stephanie/Rishi to execute)
- Today, 12:00–18:00 PDT: canary traffic with prompt_prefix_patch on 2k requests (Rishi).
- Tomorrow: share the 24-hour monitoring snapshot and next eval pass.

Please reply "CONFIRM PIN" to approve and I’ll proceed.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
